description: Keyword gap: the Google keywords a competitor ranks for and your domain does not, each with the competitor's position, URL and estimated traffic plus search volume, CPC, difficulty and intent; up to 100 in one $0.048 call. Use when you need content gaps and keyword opportunities (bare domains; www. is dropped). No gap returns empty results (still charged). Bad input is free; upstream errors are not charged. Price: $0.048 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

competitor.description: The competitor domain to compare against, e.g. example.org.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or country name, used when locationCode is absent (uk = gb).

domain.description: Your domain, e.g. example.com (no scheme or path; a leading www. is dropped).

languageCode.description: Language code (2-letter). Defaults to en. An unsupported location falls back to 2840 (United States) with en (or the requested language if the United States offers it); a supported location with a language it does not offer uses that location's default language (en if offered). Either way market.fallback is true and market.warnings says what was used.

limit.description: Maximum gap keywords to return (1-200; above 100 is lowered to 100 with a warning). Defaults to 20.

locationCode.description: Google Ads location code (geo target ID). Defaults to 2840 (United States); an unsupported code falls back to 2840 (United States, market.fallback).

name: keyword_gap
title: Keyword gap: competitor-only keywords (up to 100)
